episode_summary: This episode explores the transformative impact of AI on the real estate industry, emphasizing the need for agents to focus on relationship building and advisory roles. It also discusses the potential shifts in the market due to Zillow's influence and Compass's private listing strategies, offering insights for indie brokerages to form alliances and leverage social media for brand building.
